name: Extra Focus Technique
body:
You have unlocked a new ability to use while in your battle meditation.

Prerequisite(s): Focus technique class feature.

You gain one additional focus technique. You must meet all the prerequisites of the focus technique.

Special: You can gain Extra Focus Technique multiple times.
